description: Black Market: prepare (unsigned) buying sealed crate(s) for ETH: one transaction sending exactly price x qty (shop_info shows the price). Uses the live Games Master v2 sale, only while the Black Market event is live (otherwise answers not_on_sale and points to gm_flash_info and prepare_gm_flash_mint). Each crate holds one prize decided by a public draw when the market closes. Max 20 per call.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.
